tw: Kron straps a white headlight on his head so Ted reads in bed all night.
twc: Kron 头上绑了个白色车灯，好让泰德在床上看一整夜书。

tw: Kron wears red headphones on Ted's bed, dancing alone with an ice cream cone.
twc: Kron 戴着红耳机在泰德床上独自跳舞，手里拿着甜筒。

tw: Kron hitchhikes by the ditch, and a witch on a bike picks him up.
twc: Kron 在水沟边搭便车，一个骑自行车的女巫把他捎上了。

tw: Kron opens his door to hoarfrost, and four frosty foxes have lost their roar.
twc: Kron 一开门满地白霜，四只结霜的狐狸冻得叫不出声。

tw: Kron hurriedly stirs her curry as the worried bird really hurries him.
twc: Kron 手忙脚乱地搅着她的咖喱，着急的小鸟一个劲催他。

tw: Kron hypnotizes a hippo on a ship with snowy pies of every size.
twc: Kron 在船上用一串大大小小的雪白奶油派催眠河马。

tw: Kid Kron speaks idiomatic English, "It's raining cats," and a cat lands on his hat.
twc: 小 Kron 说地道英语“下猫了”，一只猫正好落在他帽子上。

tw: Kron, ten men and a hen see the immensity of the sea over tea.
twc: Kron、十个男人和一只母鸡边喝茶，边看大海的浩瀚。

tw: In the interteam tug of war, Kron's team slips on butter, steam and ice cream.
twc: 团队间拔河赛上，Kron 队在黄油、蒸汽和冰淇淋上滑倒了。
hint: 没输给对手，输给了冰淇淋。

tw: Kron is in trouble: his double bubble pops on a pin in the tub.
twc: Kron 有麻烦了：他的双层泡泡在浴缸里撞上了一根针。
hint: 躲在泡泡里，麻烦照样来。

tw: The kidnapper hid under a lid and napped on a paper map, so Kron snapped him.
twc: 绑匪躲在锅盖下，趴在纸地图上睡着了，Kron 咔嚓拍下了他。

tw: With one knockdown punch, Kron's sock knocks a clown's crown down in town.
twc: 一记击倒拳，Kron 的袜子拳套把小丑的王冠打落在镇上。

tw: Kron hugs a damp lamp-post at camp, and a ghost brings him toast.
twc: Kron 在营地抱着湿漉漉的灯杆，一个幽灵给他送来吐司。
hint: 幽灵送早餐，灯杆不敢放。

tw: In Lancaster, Ann's van goes faster past the castle, and Kron can't stop.
twc: 在兰卡斯特，安的面包车越开越快冲过城堡，Kron 停不下来。

tw: In Leningrad, Ben's ten hens grab Kron's hat, and Dad is glad.
twc: 在列宁格勒，本的十只母鸡抢了 Kron 的帽子，爸爸乐坏了。
hint: 帽子被鸡抢，爸爸笑开花。

tw: Kron climbs up in the limelight and bites a lime, every time, at night.
twc: Kron 每晚都爬进聚光灯下，咬一口青柠。

tw: A little litterbug sits on Kron's rug and drops bits of butter in his mug.
twc: 乱扔垃圾的小虫坐在 Kron 的地毯上，往他杯里丢黄油渣。

tw: Logically, Kron reckons a frog can't jog, but Cal the frog really jogs on a log.
twc: Kron 按逻辑认定青蛙不会跑步，青蛙卡尔却在木头上慢跑。

tw: A lumbering bear drums on plums with his thumb while Kron sings a number.
twc: 一只笨重的熊用大拇指在李子上打鼓，Kron 照样唱歌。

tw: Gosh! Mack puts Kron's macintosh in the wash, and it comes back posh.
twc: 天哪！麦克把 Kron 的苹果电脑扔进洗衣机，洗出来锃亮。
